notes:
Mercedes-Benz C-Class W203 (saloon, estate and sports coupe) and CLK W209 (C209 coupe, A209 cabriolet), the CAN-C (powertrain and chassis) units.

The address table is the W203 and W209 CAN-C database decoded from an XS Monitor file in rnd-ash/W203-canbus (MIT): every unit here is a D_RQ and D_RS frame pair the file labels KWP2000 Diagnose-Request and Diagnose-Response. The same repository's W211 and W219 CAN-C table carries every one of these pairs unchanged, so this profile shares the mercedes-w211 profile's addressing; the W211 profile lacks four of them (ehb-2, art, ism, up28) and this profile lacks the W211 table's AFS units, which the W203 table does not list. Neither file states a model year or a bit rate. The 500 kbit/s bit rate and the 0x92 session are the ones the mercedes-w211 profile uses, not read from the W203 file.

The CAN-B (interior) units in the W203 CAN-B table (EZS, SAM, KOMBI and others) are left out: they sit behind the gateway, and whether their identifiers are what reaches them from the diagnostic socket is the open question of https://github.com/Mearman/obd/issues/2 for the W211. Units are named as the source names them; a name the source does not expand is kept as written.

R171 SLK and other cars said to share the W203's electronics are not covered by this table. Treat every row as unconfirmed on a given car until obd-read probe shows the unit answering.
name: mercedes-w203-w209
description: Mercedes-Benz C-Class W203 and CLK W209, CAN-C units

vin.source: The WMIs are the Mercedes-Benz car and SUV identifiers in the world manufacturer identifier table of the Wikipedia article Vehicle identification number, which cites the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt manufacturer list SV 3.2 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number, archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261102120229/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number). Characters 4 to 6 of a Mercedes-Benz VIN in the rest-of-world form are the model series, as the Niemoeller VIN guide states with a W169 example (https://www.niemoeller.de/en/mercedes-benz-oldtimer-spare-parts/vin, archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261116163107/https://www.niemoeller.de/en/mercedes-benz-oldtimer-spare-parts/vin); a North American VIN codes the model with letters instead, so it matches none of these models.
